User: A session-scoped Stop hook is now active with condition: "read all current github issues and categorize them -- triage them in the https://github.com/users/pablof7z/projects/4/views/2 project

for issues that require some subjectivity, use an opus agent to review them -- just because an issue exists doesn't mean it should be done -- don't just follow things blindly

for things that are straightforward and slum-dunks to do, deploy a sonnet agent to PR + land them

once you are done everything that is pre v1 should have been completed and proven". Briefly acknowledge the goal, then immediately start (or continue) working toward it — treat the condition itself as your directive and do not pause to ask the user what to do. The hook will block stopping until the condition holds. It auto-clears once the condition is met — do not tell the user to run `/goal clear` after success; that's only for clearing a goal early.
